value.rationale: The source poses the structural difficulty of symmetric consecutive-power semigroups beyond low exponents, reporting only an incomplete finite search. The new bound turns one natural, exact Diophantine membership mechanism into a decidable finite problem uniformly for every exponent; the exact k=2..20 census rigorously extends bounded observations to all centers. This is more than discovering the five already partly known integers.
